pages.text: Entity wagons resist ordinary attacks, weapons and environmental damage. $(bold)Hit an actual wagon part with a carpenter’s hammer$(reset) to dismantle it in one strike. Intact parts retain wood and cloth colours. Cargo follows normal unloading rules, and riders and animals are released.

The hammer also chops wood like an iron axe, with equivalent durability and axe enchantments.$(br2)Other tools can break directly targeted world blocks, including grass inside the wagon’s broad bounds. They cannot mine through actual sideboards or the deck.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Four iron ingots, two logs or stripped logs of any type, and one stick.
